projectTitle: One Custom CRM for Orders, Delivery and Finance
summary: A cloud-kitchen CRM connecting orders, delivery, billing, finance and communication in one operational workspace.
challenge: Separate order, customer, delivery, billing and accounting processes created avoidable complexity and increased the risk of mistakes.
approach: Evolix designed the system around the daily rhythm of a Dubai cloud kitchen, connecting the flow from order intake to billing, rider assignment, delivery and finance.
outcome: One systematic workspace for key delivery operations, helping the team organise more orders with clearer control and fewer avoidable mistakes.

testimonial.quote: Managing orders, leads and accounts separately made our delivery operations difficult to control. Evolix built a custom CRM that brought everything into one systematic workspace. It has made order handling clearer, reduced avoidable mistakes and given our team the confidence to manage more orders in an organised way.
